label: boot
js: JSON.stringify({state: game.info().state, title: document.title, lang: game.info().lang})

label: check
js: (() => { const r = game.check(); return JSON.stringify({ok: r.ok, stages: r.stats.stages, fails: r.fails.slice(0, 3)}); })()

label: sabotage
js: (() => { const out = {}; for (const s of TY.check.SABOTAGE) { const r = game.check({seeds: 1, sabotage: s}); out[s] = r.ok ? 'NOT CAUGHT' : 'caught'; } return JSON.stringify(out); })()

label: lesson
js: (() => { game.G.autoPause = false; game.start({kind:'lesson', ix:3, who:'tommy', level:'easy'}); const i = game.finish(300); return JSON.stringify({state: i.state, final: i.final && i.final.map(r => [r.wpm, r.acc, r.stars])}); })()

label: adventure 2P zh
js: (() => { Kit.lang.set('zh'); game.start({kind:'adventure', ix:2, players:2}); const i = game.finish(300); return JSON.stringify({state: i.state, lang: i.lang, final: i.final && i.final.map(r => [r.id, r.wpm, r.acc, r.stars])}); })()
